title: Reflected Optimal Stopping with a Max-Type Payoff: Measure-Valued Stopping Gains and Killed Resolvent Representation
summary: We study an infinite-horizon optimal stopping problem for a two-dimensional normally reflected diffusion in the quadrant with payoff \(G(x_1,x_2)=x_1\vee αx_2\). The problem combines three features that complicate the usual free-boundary analysis: reflection on the coordinate axes, a genuinely two-dimensional stopping region, and a nonsmooth max-type reward.
